description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 Sora UI 的动效组件目录页，列出 Cursor Trail Reveal、Infinite Scrolling Images、Scroll Chapters、Scroll Gallery、Sticky Scroll Cards、Text Reveal、Box Tilt Slide Transition 等 7 个组件入口。每个组件页提供实时演示、安装命令与完整 API 参考，页面标注基于 React、TS、Tailwind、Motion、GSAP 与 shadcn。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Sora UI Catalog (https://ui.soralabs.studio/catalog).
Technology stack: react, typescript, tailwind, gsap.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
